summary: November 19, 2025 controller fixes: migrating team mappers without a users field, the 0200_template_name_constraint migration error 'column main_unifiedjobtemplate.org_unique does not exist' with duplicate template or project names in an org, worker stream 'Expecting value: line 1 column 1' JSON errors (receptorctl pin), ansible-runner 2.4.2 for aborted log streaming, and automation-controller-fapolicyd moved from python3.9 to python3.11.
questions: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0) Line with invalid JSON data
Jobs fail on fapolicyd systems without python3.9
Migration 0200_template_name_constraint fails with duplicate job template names

answer_card.title: Controller upgrade and worker-stream errors fixed Nov 19, 2025
answer_card.answer_md:
- `django.db.utils.ProgrammingError: column main_unifiedjobtemplate.org_unique does not exist` in migration `0200_template_name_constraint.py` when an org has job templates or projects with duplicate names (AAP-56222)
- `Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0) Line with invalid JSON data: b` from the worker stream: fixed by a new pinned `receptorctl` (AAP-58412, AAP-58415)
- No meaningful error when log streaming aborted: `ansible-runner` 2.4.2 (AAP-58390)
- Jobs failing on `fapolicyd` systems without python3.9: `automation-controller-fapolicyd` now uses python3.11 (AAP-55790)

Apply the November 19, 2025 patch or later.
